title: X2 Evidence-Authority Correction — Canonical Schema Authority Repair

defect_detail.summary: Published JSON Schema files under docs/schemas/ require more fields than the runtime inline schemas actually validate. The runtime claimed canonical governed evidence while enforcing weaker private schemas — only 3 required fields for execution receipts vs 9 in the published canonical schema, and only 2 required fields for cache events vs 5 in the published canonical schema. Additionally, tool proposal evidence was routed through the execution ledger validated against the wrong schema.

affected_schemas.canonical_requires: required: [receipt_id, operation_id, task_id_hash, status, prompt_sha256, output_sha256, model_id_hash, content_light, schema_version]
affected_schemas.additional_gap: emitted payloads included cache_hit which is not in the canonical schema (additionalProperties: false)

affected_schemas.inline_was: not used — tool proposal evidence routed through execution ledger with execution schema

repair_applied.strategy: Replace inline schema dicts with loaded canonical JSON Schema files from docs/schemas/. Add separate tool proposal ledger. Fix all emitted payloads to satisfy canonical required fields.
key_changes: _evidence.py: _load_canonical_schema + _resolve_schema_path helpers load schemas from published JSON files
_service.py: refusal payloads include all 9 required canonical fields
test: TestCanonicalSchemaAuthority: 7 tests prove schemas are canonical files, valid payloads pass, old weak payloads rejected
test: TestRealEvidenceEmission: rewritten to validate against canonical schemas

resulting_status: candidate_local — corrected candidate boundary, pending prepublication review
content_light_guarantee: All evidence payloads remain content-light. No raw prompts, model outputs, file contents, or secrets in any evidence artifact.
